verdict.rationale: Tavily is API-first, and every core capability is a documented API endpoint: search, extract, crawl, map, research, plus research status and streaming. Dashboard-style data is also exposed through API endpoints for key and account usage and for per-request logs, and the Python/JS SDKs and CLI wrap the same API. Missing for 10: any explicit statement of UI/API parity, API-based management of keys, billing or team/org settings, and independent hands-on corroboration.
